description: Reply triage for the inbox: people the user has written to before whose latest email came after the user's latest email to them, in the last two weeks. Use only when the user asks which emails or replies are waiting on them. It is not a list of who to catch up with, reconnect with or follow up with, and it does not know whether a message asks for anything: read the message before saying someone needs an answer. People outside the user's own company come first, then coworkers, each longest wait first. Each has name, email, mailbox, when they last wrote, when the user last wrote, the days waited, and `coworker` when they work at the user's own company.
name: mail_waiting_on_me
title: Mail waiting on you
